title: Research Problems in Function Theory — Problem 7.25
exact_target: For a compact set of positive area, find holomorphic functions whose difference quotients avoid the two specified values, ask whether bounded difference quotients are possible, and determine which other prescribed sets of values can be omitted.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 2307025 (AMR-022-7025). CC BY4.0.
W. K. Hayman and E. F. Lingham, \emph{Research Problems in Function Theory} (2018), Chapter7, Problem7.25 and its complete update.
